title: Configuration core determined by its code
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $s$ be a natural number. Suppose configurations $C$ and $D$ both have all work-tape heads within distance $s$ of the origin and have blank tape cells at every position of absolute value greater than $s$. If their configuration codes at radius $s$ are equal, then their cores agree: they have the same state, input-head position, work-tape contents, work-tape head positions, and output summary (empty, exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$, or no longer capable of becoming $[\mathrm{true}]$).
